visual.description: Warm ivory cream used for the page background, nav bar, and footer — the base canvas of the site.
Pure black used for all body text, headings, nav links, and icon strokes.
Deep indigo-black dominant in the cinematic hero and editorial video sections — the brand's dark atmospheric tone.
Medium gray used for secondary/utility text and ghost button outlines.
Black used for the CTA button border (outlined ghost style).
Light warm gray appearing behind product imagery cards in the grid sections.
